title: How an Air Fryer Works in 60 Seconds 🍟🌀 #shorts
description:
An air fryer doesn't fry at all. It's a small convection oven: a heating element and a powerful fan blast hot air around the food in a perforated basket. Fast-moving hot air dries the surface and triggers browning reactions for a crispy crust with little oil. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#airfryer #howitworks #shorts

steps.label: Hook
steps.text: An air fryer doesn't fry. It's really a tiny, *super-fast oven*.

steps.label: Element
steps.text: At the top, a coiled *heating element* glows red hot.

steps.label: Fan
steps.text: Right above it, a strong *fan* blasts that heat down and around the food.

steps.label: Basket
steps.text: Holes in the *basket* let hot air swirl underneath, so every side gets hit.

steps.label: Dry surface
steps.text: Fast-moving air whips moisture off the surface, so it *dries* instead of steaming.

steps.label: Crispy
steps.text: A dry, hot surface browns through the *Maillard reaction*, making a crispy crust with *little oil*.

steps.label: Recap
steps.text: Heat, fan, *crunch*. Follow Inside 60 for more.
